display.entryTitle: Queue Third Light Low Rock Mickey

description: Right beside the last U-turn Mickey is a fourth one, about two feet left of the third courtesy light and only a foot off the ground.

whereToLook.scene: The last right U-turn before boarding, the wall on your left
whereToLook.exactSpot: Two feet left of the third courtesy light, a foot off the ground. Three rocks.

bestTip: Low. Look down near your feet.
